subject: SOC2+DPA + pen-test dry run: availability fingerprint & escalation path
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara@NimbusSys.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rios <alex.rios@nimbussys.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security walkthrough + pen-test dry run — initial availability

Hi David,

Thanks again for taking the time to help us through the SOC 2 / DPA review and the upcoming pen test next month. We want to run a short dry run with Redwood prior to the formal pen-test kickoff to sanity-check evidence access, timing, and the escalation path if we hit a blocker.

Ideal outcomes for the dry run:
- Verify evidence handoff flow (S3 / shared Drive link)
- Exercise on-call escalation and contact list
- Confirm a 45–60 minute call cadence that mirrors the pen vendor's expectations

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed 15 Oct, 16:00–17:00 PT
- Thu 16 Oct, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Fri 17 Oct, 20:00–21:00 PT (evening window for our APAC vendor)

I've attached a short scope doc and a draft runbook. Can you confirm who from Redwood should join and whether you need additional artifacts ahead of time?

Thanks,
Tara
Security Program Manager
Nimbus Systems
[Attachment: nimbus-scope.pdf (PDF, 230KB)]

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@NimbusSys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough + pen-test dry run — initial availability

Tara — thanks for the clear outcomes and the scope doc. Short answer: yes, we can run a dry run and will treat it as a lightweight rehearsal for the vendor kick.

Who we'll include from our side: me (security intake), Laura (ops handoff), Ben (customer success / vendor liaison). Marcus can be on standby for any runtime/inference-serving questions.

Quick asks before the dry run:
1) Please confirm whether the pen vendor needs temporary read-only S3 credentials or a shared Drive read link.
2) If you have a prioritized evidence list (controls -> artifacts), drop that as a one-pager.

Of your windows, Thu 16 Oct 09:00–10:00 PT works best for our on-call rotation. If that fills, we can cover Wed 15 Oct 16:00–17:00 PT as a fallback; the evening slot we'd only take if your APAC vendor truly requires it.

I'll send a calendar poll and attach a short internal runbook we use for dry runs.

-David
David Kim
Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook-dryrun.odt (ODT, 18KB)]

Thanks — looping in logistical details so we all have the same escalation path.

Laura here (ops). A couple of operational notes:
- Primary escalation: david_kim@redwood.com -> Ben Carter (CS) -> Marcus Lin (Serving Runtime).
- Secondary (out-of-hours): oncall+security@redwood.com (we'll provide the group alias if you need it).
- Access pattern: for a dry run, a Drive read link is preferable (simpler); if the vendor requires S3, please advise and we'll create a temporary role scoped to the evidence prefix.

Proposed meeting: Thu, 16 Oct 2025 09:00–10:00 PT — confirmed pending your calendar invite.

If that changes we can take Wed 15 Oct 16:00–17:00 PT as a one-hour backup. For the fallback evening slot, we would need Marcus to commit to late hours; he's okay to be on standby but would prefer it be a last resort.

On attachments: I've added a short checklist into the Drive link David referenced (see calendar invite once scheduled).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
